horse_profiles.owner_name: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

quotes.notes: It's pretty exciting. Bow Echo is a colt who has always shown us that. I felt like we'd almost gone a little bit overboard on what we thought of him before the race but that's what he was showing me. His lead horse might not be a superstar but we've had some Group One horses who haven't gone by him and the fact that he goes eight, ten lengths past tells us that he's a good one. He just exudes confidence. Special mention for the rider. Billy [Loughnane] is only 20 and to hold his nerve and to do what he did. But this horse has stood out from the word go. For his generation he looks a very good horse. Gstaad is a Breeders' Cup winner and at the back-end of his two-year-old year I wanted to run him in a Dewhurst or a Breeders' Cup but Sheikh Mohammed Obaid was watching today and he'll be telling me 'I was right!' and he was. He's matured, he's strengthened and I sent him a video last year of how I wanted to run him in the Dewhurst and he told me 'he's not running because he's a child' and everyone saw that here. He's matured - he was a child against men last year and now he's the top of the pile. I think he's a fast horse who stays which is obviously a huge asset. He's not a Derby horse I don't think. He's not in the Derby - he has always shown a huge turn of foot and I want to make him the Champion Miler if we can. The Irish Guineas is there, he's obviously in at Ascot and then he has to take on the older horses. But we'd be looking to try and make him a dual Guineas winner I would say, but he will tell us. He's a very expressive horse - George Boughey, trainer.Bow Echo is an absolute superstar and he's a dream to ride. I planned the race out in a million different directions but it went perfectly today. What a feeling. He'd had a perfect preparation going into the race and George is a genius. He's done everything right with this horse and it just shows when he gets a star what he can do with it. Bow Echo - what a superstar! - Billy Loughnane, jockey.

quotes.raceTitle: Tattersalls Online Royal Lodge Stakes (Group 2) (Colts & Geldings)
quotes.notes: Bow Echo got a lovely ride. Billy [Loughnane] allowed him to relax early. I was keen to do it the right way round - we could have been forward and tried to make a test of it, but he has got a turn of foot and it was nice to see it today. He is still a very raw animal but certainly a very good one. He is certainly much the best colt I have trained. We have had some nice fillies but he is head and shoulders above the rest of them. He is a miler at the moment for sure. His pedigree goes back to some ten-furlong horses, but we are pretty confident at a mile at the moment and it was a nice trial for May (the Betfred 2,000 Guineas). The Guineas is very much the plan and I don't think he's a horse that needs to trial. He is a Group Two winner at two and hopefully all being well he will come straight back here next year - George Boughey, trainer.

Bow Echo is a lovely horse who has shown plenty of ability at home, but he's possibly still quite raw. It looked like Publish was coming to win the race, but our horse was waiting for him and outbattled him in the end. I think we'll just see how he comes out of the race. He's very much a horse for next year. Maybe we could step him up in class again this year, but I'd be quite happy to wait and run him in a Guineas trial next spring. He has plenty of pace, he's a Guineas horse and that's what we'll be training him for - George Boughey, trainer.

quotes.raceTitle: TPT Fire Supports St Michaels Hospice EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
quotes.notes: It was a taking performance. Bow Echo's work had been good at home and I've always liked him. I couldn't believe how well I was going at the two-furlong pole. He's got a long way to go before that [being a credible 2,000 Guineas candidate] and we're not 100 per cent sure what he's beaten, but I'd imagine George [Boughey, trainer] will have options for him. I thought he'd take a lot of beating but he's got to step up to any Classic credentials - Billy Loughnane, jockey.

stable_tour_quotes.notes: He's going straight to the Guineas. He's very clean-winded and has plenty of boot. He stayed a mile at two and he makes my job very easy. It's all systems go for Newmarket and he's undoubtedly the best colt we've trained - it's very exciting. The fact we're not trialling probably opens up the Irish 2,000 Guineas but his next start will determine everything. I'd love to take the typical route of running in the Guineas and the St James's Palace before taking on the older horses. He's showing us all the right signs that he's on track for a big summer. 02-04-26
